preconditions.description: The input contains a single integer A within the range [1, 10^12].
The input consists of exactly one token.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for x in range(1, 2*A + 1) if sum(d for d in range(1, x + 1) if x % d == 0) == int(stdin.strip()))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct positive integers x such that the sum of all positive divisors of x equals A. The search space for x is bounded by 2*A because the sum of divisors of x is at least x + 1 (for x > 1) or 1 (for x=1), and for any x > 2*A, the sum of divisors exceeds A.
